body.asks: What a question about everything means where a store cannot give all it holds, as a git repository gives its tip but not every tree of every commit at once: whether all() says what it gave, and whether a type's instances there mean those reached so far.

name: A store that cannot give everything

body.asks: How a route of names reads where a name belongs to the tree that holds a thing, not to the thing, as one blob stands under many names: whether a route reads entries' names, or entries become holons of their own.

Whether an integration's ids are a marker beyond any moment glass mints, a facet, and the first characters of the source's own hash, so the same object has the same id in every clone and an id leads back to its object; a change to what an id may be, so a vector first.

name: Ids derived from what is read

body.asks: When the engine stops standing on glass's own format: it now reads any store through Source, the five things it asks of a store it reads; writing still needs glass's own store, and canonical text and hashing stay with the format until a store of another kind is written.

name: The engine's contract with a store
